title: MetadataRecord
description: Authoritative field-level payload schema for the MetadataRecord family of UCOS-DATA-CONTRACT-018 (API-018 Configuration & Metadata, GET /metadata/{class}). A MetadataRecord is one key-addressed metadata entry, optionally described by an attached schema, classified under one of the metadata classes MC-01..13 (UCOS-INF-ARCH-001). Field authority: UCOS-PDATA-ARCH-001. Fields are derived directly from the implemented Metadata substrate (MetadataPort/MetadataRecord, metadata-runtime, EV-PI23-BUILD VERIFIED) and API-018 operation intent. Classification is inherited (MC-01) and is not duplicated as a payload field.

schema.description: One metadata record: key, value, and optional describing schema.
Metadata key (prefix-queryable). Source authority: MetadataRecord.key (meta-core/ports.ts; metadata-store.ts query-by-prefix).
Metadata class MC-01..13 the record belongs to. Source authority: API-018 GET /metadata/{class} + Information/Metadata Architecture MC-01..13 (UCOS-INF-ARCH-001).
The metadata value. Open object: an arbitrary structured value. Source authority: MetadataRecord.value (meta-core/ports.ts; typed as unknown, narrowed to a structured record here by field authority).

Optional JSON-Schema (subset) describing/validating the value on write. Open object mirrors the substrate JsonSchema shape. Source authority: MetadataRecord.schema + MetadataPort.validate (metadata-runtime/schema-validator.ts).
